mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, compressing valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (25th percentile), or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces forward earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering profit downgrade expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down >0.5% MoM) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and stronger corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through higher earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1200 thousand units signals weakening residential construction and broader consumer demand, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signal persistent inflation requiring aggressive tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 3.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 3.5) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY) increases recession risk and profit margin compression, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as valuations adjust downward.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling window.
